Title: UI Architecture Current State
Content: MemorySmith uses Blazor Server with Interactive Server render mode on all pages. The host is MemorySmith.App with MudBlazor 9.4 for components. Pages: /memories (MemoryViewer.razor) is the main workbench, a VS Code-inspired compact dark editor for browsing and editing MemoryRecords with inline source link editing and agent-context copy. /pages (Pages.razor) manages markdown project-wiki pages, rendered previews, and page assets. /chat (Chat.razor) has a collapsible history sidebar with compact ellipsis titles, provider/model dropdowns, Chat/Agent toggle buttons, streamed response status, visible assistant provider/model metadata, local draft/history persistence, icon Stop and Finish Step controls with tooltips, attachment chips, neutral preloaded context chips, blue mid-chat tool resource chips, green agent write chips for created pages, and a global Trace side panel that shows the selected turn's compact execution graph, interleaved reasoning, tool calls/results, write approvals, token estimates, tool latency, filters, collapsible trace headers, and editable tool reruns. The Trace panel hides history on medium viewports and becomes a bottom pane on smaller viewports to avoid squeezing the chat column. Agent writes proposed by the model require explicit approve/reject actions in the Trace panel before they are applied. /health (HealthStats.razor) shows stat cards, two MudChart<double> activity charts, maintenance telemetry, diagnostics, and recent events. /variables (Variables.razor) is a simple CRUD table for vars.json bindings used in source link %VarName% expansion. All pages use MVVM-lite: minimal code-behind, services injected. MudBlazor 9.4 breaking changes: MudChart is now generic (MudChart T='double', ChartSeries<double>), axis labels use ChartLabels not XAxisLabels. CSS is in wwwroot/app.css.
